# `/merge`

> Address PR comments, squash merge, and update local main

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/merge.md — do not edit -->

Answers PR review comments, squash merges, updates `main` and removes the feature worktree and branches.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/merge <pr-number>` |
| **Reads** | PR, comments (via `gh`) |
| **Writes** | merge commit on `main`; removes worktree and branches |
| **Gates** | You confirm the squash message and any reply to a comment you'd dismiss. |
| **Next** | `/specify` (next feature) |
| **Tools** | `Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, ExitWorktree` |
